description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot REST controller named KafkaDemoController that provides an endpoint to send messages to a Kafka topic. It uses annotations for API documentation and dependency injection, and exposes a POST endpoint at /api/kafka/send.

classes.name: KafkaDemoController
classes.description: A REST controller exposing an endpoint to send messages to Kafka.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles POST requests to send a message to a Kafka topic, using the KafkaProducerService.
